# Pinned Octop source view

`upstream.tar.gz` is a deterministic filtered source view at the fixed commit in `manifest.json`, preserving all allowed regular members byte for byte. It is source material, not a second running Octop server. Main Office DOCX/PDF/PPTX/XLSX resource subtrees (186 members) carry independent copying/distribution restrictions and are excluded from this view and the capability package. Their paths and original member hashes remain receipts; the functional targets remain for independent implementations.

`archive_sha256` is the original upstream artifact digest; `retained_archive_sha256` is the filtered view digest. `source_files` records the original regular-member hashes, while `retained_source_files` and `excluded_source_files` explicitly separate retained bytes and absent resources. The original artifact and member inventory were verified before curation. Offline validation checks retained bytes against independent pinned member-inventory digests and the receipt; it does not reconstruct or re-hash absent original artifacts. Root licenses and notices remain. Symlinks from upstream are never followed or materialized.

`imports` lists 849 byte-identical files in the host-neutral capability package. Adapters, catalog and source-policy code are host implementation. Runtime imports only the four explicitly selected pure upstream modules; it never loads bundled plugins or scripts. Expert catalog responses identify excluded resources as pending independent implementations.

Run `python3 scripts/octop_sync.py verify`. Evaluate an original candidate with `compare --archive /path/to/source.tar.gz --revision COMMIT --release TAG --output /tmp/octop-candidate.json`; then accept it in a candidate branch, review independent licenses and dependencies, and import it with the same options and the `import` command. For an already curated view, supply `--receipt /path/to/manifest.json`; a known filtered archive cannot be imported as an original artifact. Review and freeze origin/member digest anchors when accepting a new source version, and run behavior, artifact, migration and rollback gates before promotion.

Four external distributions are recorded separately under `external/`, without installation or activation. Only their allowed source inputs and original artifact/member/metadata receipts are delivered. Current full capability parity remains an implementation target. The current working tree and candidate artifacts have been curated; pre-existing Git history has not been rewritten, and historical trees require separate review before public distribution.
